about: Extra reference captures (npm run capture:reference -- --extra tests/golden/extra-cases.json): a preset with overrides set after the preset and the seed, at seeds 7 and 4242 unless `seeds` says otherwise, home and orbit cameras, and (from M3) the zoom camera for the seeds a case lists in `zoom`: home at zoom 2 through v21's __GEN.zoom, so VIEW.scale = 168 (open question Q8). They are the required golden cases (tests/golden/README.md, ADR 0015). 'stipple': lines, knots and envelope off, as the roadmap's M2 acceptance says (the arms, the spurs and the clumps' marks are drawn; the lines, the knots and the envelope come with later milestones' own cases); 'Radio jet' also has its jet off (the Sersic profile). Seeds 3 and 11 give v21 hands of 2 and 3 pens. 'stipple-arms' is Grand design with vary 0 (no spurs, clumps or dust patches, lopsidedness or warp, and every dot drawing) and dustScribble 0 (no dust lanes). From M4, 'ribbons' (seeds 7 and 4242, home, orbit and zoom): the M4 presets with bubbles 0, whole 0 and envelope 0 (rings drawings at the clumps, whole drawings and envelopes, vector parts that M5 draws and these cases leave to its own); Barred spiral draws its bar and ring as ribbons (barStyle and ringStyle 'ribbon') instead of the vector drawings of its default style. From M5, 'vectors': the M5 presets as v21 draws them, with their drawn parts; 'Shell galaxy' draws its drawn shells (shells 1) instead of its simulated ones (shellsOn 0; the shell simulation is M8). From M7 none of these cases switches off the drawn stars among the dots (starMix), the deep field (field) or the foreground stars (fgstars): they were overrides of M2 to M5, retired when M7 built the stars and the sky (ADR 0031), and the captures were made again with them on. The stars, artefacts, layered scenes and the deep field are tests/golden/m7-cases.json.
